item.title: Oscar-nominated 'The Devil Is Busy' looks at women's reproductive rights
item.description: One of this year's Oscar-nominated documentary shorts is "The Devil Is Busy," a half hour film about reproductive rights.

item.title: CA official calling on Trump admin. to return deaf Bay Area boy, his family deported to Colombia
item.description: State Superintendent Tony Thurmond says the six-year-old boy does not have his hearing aids with him. He is now asking new Homeland Security Secretary nominee, Senator Markwayne Mullin, to call President Trump and find out where the family is, and bring them home.

item.title: Casting nominee reacts to Oscars' first new category in 25 years
item.description: This new category is one that's behind-the-scenes, but without it, there could be no movie magic. Once there's a script, there needs to be actors to play the roles. That's where casting directors come in.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Clear skies overnight; warming trend continues this weekend
item.description: The warming trend will continue this weekend with highs well above average for this time of year. Skies will remain clear overnight and the winds gusty in some areas going into tomorrow.

item.description: Here's how to watch ABC7 Eyewitness News' broadcast of the largest Lunar New Year Celebration outside of Asia.

item.title: Preparations underway for SF's 2026 Chinese New Year Parade: Here's a look
item.description: Union Square was buzzing with activity Friday as crews set up the bleacher seats, live broadcast center and barricades as preparations are underway for Saturday's Chinese New Year Parade in San Francisco.

item.title: Dublin teachers to go on strike Monday if no deal is reached with school district
item.description: If the teachers strike, it will be the first-ever strike since Dublin became its own district in the 1980s.

item.title: Crowded race: 10 candidates officially running to be your next governor of California
item.description: Ten major candidates are officially in the running for California governor as of Friday, the filing deadline, marking what political observers say is the most competitive gubernatorial primary the state has seen in years.

item.title: Olympic gold medalist Eileen Gu embraces SF roots, leads SF Chinese New Year Parade celebrations
item.description: Freestyle skiing champion and international model Eileen Gu is preparing for a homecoming of a different kind as she steps into the role of grand marshal for the San Francisco Chinese New Year Parade on Saturday. For the 22‑year‑old, the honor carries deep personal meaning rooted in her childhood and her connection to the city where she was born and raised.

item.title: SF mayor was 'worried' about 2 men on street, checked on them before bodyguard attack
item.description: Mayor Lurie's bodyguard was seen on the ground struggling with an individual. Seconds later, more police reinforcement arrived. One resident who wants to remain anonymous but shared a video of the incident, said the mayor went to get more help.
